scope: Read-only diagnosis of the isolated Inno Setup candidate rollback

write_probe.attempt: Open the parent Uninstall key with write access using the current process token
write_probe.result: Windows/.NET rejected the write-capable open with Requested registry access is not allowed

interpretation: The initial ordinary sandbox run was denied while creating the per-user uninstall entry. A later sandbox-approved rerun installed and uninstalled the same candidate under the same Windows user, confirming that the denial came from the managed sandbox boundary rather than a defective Windows user-profile ACL. No ACL or registry value was changed manually.
acceptance: The sandbox-specific registry-write blocker is resolved for this isolated smoke. The candidate remains unpromoted pending native window launch, clean Windows 11 acceptance, code signing, and user acceptance.
